ammonia.reason: Low amino acid deamination during short indoor aging, no surface flora urease activity.

animal_barnyard.reason: Pasteurized cow milk and Lactococcus starter gives very low p-cresol and indole.

bitter.reason: Moderate rennet and starter proteolysis yields few hydrophobic bitter peptides, mostly degraded.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti, so no 2-heptanone/2-nonanone blue methyl ketone pathway.

browning.reason: Maillard between residual galactose/peptides and casein on heating gives moderate browning.

buttery.reason: Lactococcus lactis biovar diacetylactis citrate fermentation yields high diacetyl and acetoin.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Mild lipolysis by milk lipase and starter esterases releases some butanoic and hexanoic acid.

creaminess.reason: High fat 35% and 37.9% moisture with pressed smooth curd gives creamy mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: Cheddared pressed calcium-paracasein network is smooth-firm, fractures little when young.

firmness.reason: Low moisture 37.9%, rennet gel plus cheddaring/pressing gives firm dense body.

floral_honey.reason: Low phenylalanine catabolism to phenylacetaldehyde and 2-phenylethanol by starter.

fruity.reason: Limited esterase activity forms low ethyl butanoate and ethyl hexanoate during 4-month aging.

goaty.reason: Cow milk fat lacks high 4-methyloctanoic and 4-ethyloctanoic branched-chain acids.

malty_nutty.reason: Strecker degradation of leucine/isoleucine to 3-methylbutanal and 2-methylbutanal during aging.

melt.reason: Rennet curd at pH 5.2 with intact casein and 35% fat flows well on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: No Geotrichum/mold lipoxygenase, so very low 1-octen-3-ol and 1-octen-3-one.

oil_off.reason: 35% milkfat coalesces and oils off moderately when melted due to contracted protein matrix.

smoky.reason: Typically unsmoked, no wood-smoke phenols like guaiacol.

sour_vinegar.reason: Most lactose fermented to lactic acid then buffered, low acetic acid retention.

stretch.reason: Non-pasta-filata cheddared curd lacks aligned demineralized paracasein for stretching.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Low methionine catabolism to methanethiol and dimethyl sulfide without high heat.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose depletion plus delta-decalactone/dodecalactone and diacetyl gives mild sweet.

umami.reason: 4-month starter peptidase proteolysis releases moderate glutamate and savory peptides.
